SMALL TOOLS, USEFUL HABITS

Rucking tools & templates

Practical checklists and session logs for planning, training and reviewing your rucks.

01

Before a long ruck

  • Route, distance, elevation and weather checked
  • Pack fitted and load secure
  • Water, food, clothing and lighting considered
  • Turnaround and contact plan agreed
02

After a benchmark

  • Distance, elapsed time, terrain and load noted
  • What felt good and what slowed you down
  • Any equipment or foot-care issues
  • One change for next time
03

For a group ruck

  • Time and place publicised
  • Route and expected pace explained
  • Regroup points and alternative finish agreed
  • One person keeps track of everyone at the finish
